v1_3_1.title: More flexible arrangements, safer drafts
highlights: Drag the right edge of a track to extend or shorten it, with a snap preview for bars and note endings. Extending a shortened region brings its hidden notes back.
Song duration follows the active track regions. Preview and MIDI export use the same range; importing an exported file no longer adds an empty track.
New 1/64, 1/128 and 1/256 grids allow finer rhythm edits when zoomed in. Fixed uneven grid spacing and accidental notes while dragging scrollbars.
Each project and song arrangement keeps its own draft. Return to the same entry to restore it after closing; restoring a detached window preserves its source.
Songs and playlists show recently added songs first. Track resizing help is more complete, and the update entry is simpler.

v1_3_0.title: Arrange MIDI directly in the app
highlights: The new MIDI editor lets you create projects, edit notes and manage tracks, with undo, redo, project saving and MIDI export. Start an arrangement directly from song details.
Open the track overview and piano roll in a separate window for more room to browse and edit.
More flexible piano roll zoom, seeking and drag previews make long songs easier to navigate. Empty tracks can be hidden.
Failed update downloads try another route, with cancellation and recovery. Unsaved edits are protected before installation.

v1_2_0.title: Smoother performance, steadier previews
highlights: Improved long notes, short notes and repeated pitches to reduce interruptions and missed notes. Keys are released promptly when pausing, stopping or changing songs.
MIDI preview stays smoother while navigating pages. Quick song changes and pause recovery no longer keep playing the previous song.
The new Stop after playback mode suits single-song recording. Progress tips show minutes and seconds.
MIDI files dropped onto a playlist join that playlist directly. The online library adapts its columns to the window width.

v1_1_4.title: Playback queues follow library changes
highlights: Fixed previous, next and automatic queue navigation for consistent looping.
Preview queues update when songs or playlists change. Press Esc to exit batch selection.

v1_1_3.title: Smoother update downloads in China
highlights: Added an accelerated update route for China and a fallback when an update source times out.

v1_1_2.title: More accurate song information
highlights: Fixed inflated durations for multi-track songs and melody note counts displaying zero.
Added a notice explaining that online scores are for learning and sharing.

v1_1_1.title: Easier template and playlist actions
highlights: Saving a template keeps the current performance template instead of switching unexpectedly.
Delete actions consistently appear last. Fixed lingering nested menus and refined menu icons and tooltips.

v1_1_0.title: Organize your music with playlists
highlights: Create playlists with covers, organize songs, duplicate playlists, and import or export them.
Browse the new online MIDI library and import more scores.
Choose sequential, shuffle, repeat-one or repeat-all playback consistently across the main and overlay views.
Seek and locate the current song in overlay mode. Optional game frame-rate detection helps adapt performance timing.

v1_0_0.title: First stable release: build your own templates
highlights: Manage templates in a visual 88-key editor: click a piano key, then press a physical key to bind it. Includes undo, redo, drafts, import and export.
Shared preview controls keep progress, volume and queue actions consistent between the main and overlay views.
Refined desktop title bars and menus, with better window restoration after macOS fullscreen and overlay changes.

v0_3_2.title: Guidance for restoring accessibility access
highlights: Added instructions for reauthorizing macOS accessibility access after an update, with permission hints and contact details in Help.

v0_3_1.title: More accurate macOS permission checks
highlights: Fixed accessibility permission detection after updates to reduce cases where an authorized app cannot perform.

v0_3_0.title: Better in-game performance and updates
highlights: Fixed macOS in-game key simulation for letters, the number row and F1–F12.
Improved in-app update detection, downloading and installation, and increased MIDI preview volume.
Overlay song changes retain the performance countdown. Improved missed short notes.

v0_2_3.title: Music to try on your first launch
highlights: Added four bundled MIDI examples: Interstellar (piano), Summer from Kikujiro, sky03 and Xiaguang.

v0_2_2.title: Fixed update button interactions
highlights: Fixed errors when starting an update and refined the update entry and notifications.

v0_2_1.title: Completed macOS update support
highlights: Fixed in-app update availability on Apple Silicon Macs.

v0_2_0.title: In-app updates and clearer previews
highlights: Added automatic update detection on launch, with downloading, installation and restart inside the app.
Improved macOS key simulation and preview volume while preserving note dynamics.

v0_1_0.title: From MIDI to in-game performance
highlights: First release: import MIDI scores and perform automatically in Infinity Nikki with key mapping templates and pitch adaptation. Includes overlay mode and Chinese and English interfaces.
